| NASA RESPONSE to Measure#T = |

e NASA Office of Small Business Programs (OSBP) has formed a team comprised of Small Business |
Specialists and Center procurement individuals to update the FY 2008 OSBP strategic plan. I

e NASA established the FY-2008 Small Businesses Improvement Plan, which is a strategy to increase the i
number of competitively awarded contracts to small businesses during the period. (Enclosure 1) |

e NASA holds quarterly Small Business Specialists Council meetings to address all small business issues |
and strategies to increase the number of competitively awarded contracts to small businesses. /

e =InFY 2008, NASA will be rolling out a new Mentor Protégé Program that will increase the number of |
competitively awarded contracts by increasing the number of small business participants and |
streamlining the administrative processes of the program.

e The Assistant Administrator, OSBP, will speak at the NASA Procurement Officers Conference about |
the agency’s Scorecard rating; to solicit support for the Small Business Program’s effort to increase the \
number of competitively awarded contracts to small businesses during the period. |

e The NASA Procurement Tenets support competitively awarded contracts and the inclusion of small
businesses in the agency’s integrated acquisition strategies. (Enclosure 2)

Brief Agency CommentforScoreard)
The NASA strategic plan contains both documented policies and procedures and initiatives to increase
competitively awarded to small businesses. As documented in enclosure (3) the Office of Procurement |
Tenets stresses competition and the use of small businesses. The new NASA Small Business Advocates i
Awards strongly incentivises the procurement, technical, and program management communities to |
increase awards to small businesses with a check for $5,000 to each group that support awards to small i
businesses. These efforts are documented in enclosure (4). i

e The Assistant Administrator, OSBP, briefed the NASA Operations Management Council (OMC) in
September 2007, and is scheduled to brief the council again in FY 2008, on the status of the Small i
Business Program. The OMC is chaired by the Deputy Administrator and is made up of all ten Center |
Directors and NASA senior staff. i
e The Assistant Administrator, OSBP, briefed the NASA Advisory Council (NAC) in July 2007, and is

The NAC is the Agency’s Board of Directors. :

Senior Management support at NASA is exceptional. As the Assistant Administrator for the Office of Small L
Business Programs, I am afforded access to the agency’s Board of Directors and every NASA senior |

and to solicit their commitment to improving every aspect of the program. The Administrator and Deputy I

4) i
